rutger_rocket.name: Rocket Launcher
rutger_rocket.desc:
Launch a rocket that deals damage in an area and applies knockback.
Rutger receives 50% damage and 175% knockback from his own rocket if he's in its impact radius.

rutger_force_field.name: Force Field
rutger_force_field.desc: Create a field at target location that pushes enemies away from its outer edge.

rutger_cheat_death.name: Cheat Death
rutger_cheat_death.desc: When taking otherwise fatal damage, Rutger becomes unkillable for 4s.

tiers.text: +50% Bonus move speed when Cheat Death activates.
+100% Bullet Lifesteal when Cheat Death activates.

rutger_pulse.name: Pulse
rutger_pulse.desc:
Release a fast pulse in a large area that damages, slows, and prevents enemies from using abilities.
The damage dealt is based on how close the enemy is to the center of the pulse.

citadel_ability_kali_spinning_blade.name: Occilioblade
citadel_ability_kali_spinning_blade.quip: Launch a boomerang that flies back
citadel_ability_kali_spinning_blade.desc: Throw a spinning blade that deals damage and returns to you.

tiers.text: +40 Damage and Occilioblade gains +100% more damage from spirit
-7s Cooldown for each enemy hit by Occilioblade

ability_kali_dust_storm.name: Dust Storm
ability_kali_dust_storm.quip: Send out a tornado that slows enemies
ability_kali_dust_storm.desc: Send out a tornado that damages enemies it touches, as well as applying a lingering movement and fire rate slow.

citadel_ability_kali_disruptive_charge.name: Pack Hunter
citadel_ability_kali_disruptive_charge.quip: You and nearby allies move much faster
citadel_ability_kali_disruptive_charge.desc: Provides a large speed bonus to you and nearby allies. The speed bonus decays over time.

tiers.text: 30% Damage Lifesteal for the duration of Pack Hunter

ability_kali_trappers_bolo.name: Trapper's Delight
ability_kali_trappers_bolo.desc: Throw a bolo that bounces between enemy heroes before returning to you. Victims will slow down over 2s and then become immobilized for 2s. Bounces once per hero.

tiers.text: Enemies hit by the bolo give 30% Lifesteal for 8s

yakuza_kobun.name: Hired Muscle
yakuza_kobun.desc: Summons a subordinate gangster to follow a friendly unit and attack enemies closest to that target. Double tap to self cast.

bonuses.label: to Gangster Health
bonuses.value: Gangster Health20% of The Boss' health

yakuza_shakedown_target.name: Shakedown
yakuza_shakedown_target.desc: Send a drone to lock an area down, rooting and damaging enemies in the area. The link between your drones shares a portion of the damage you take with a random rooted enemy.

yakuza_setting_sun.name: Setting Sun
yakuza_setting_sun.desc: Call down a precision Gamma Ray blast from orbit, hitting all units in the radius at every height regardless of cover. Units near the center of the beam take more damage.

yakuza_protection_racket.name: Protection Racket
yakuza_protection_racket.desc: Create a protective force shield to protect an ally and increase their crit damage. Purges negative effects on the target when cast.

tiers.text: -60% Weapon Recoil, -60% move speed reduction when shooting.

bonuses.label: move speed penalty while shooting reduction

ability_explosive_barrel.name: Powder Keg
ability_explosive_barrel.quip: Throw a barrel that explodes when shot
ability_explosive_barrel.desc:
Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage, setting enemies on fire and applying knockup.
The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel.
The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage.
Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel in front of Holliday.

tiers.text:
+40 Impact Damage
+13.333 Burn Damage per Second
-5s Charge Time
Improved Spirit Scaling

ability_bounce_pad.name: Bounce Pad
ability_bounce_pad.desc:
Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero.
You explode on landing, dealing  Damage to any nearby enemies.
The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.

tiers.text: You and allies gain a +4m/s move speed bonus for 4s on landing

ability_gravity_lasso.name: Spirit Lasso
ability_gravity_lasso.quip: Grab an enemy and drag them behind you
ability_gravity_lasso.desc:
Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage, pulling, and applying stun.
Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.

ability_crackshot.name: Crackshot
ability_crackshot.desc:
Headshots deal bonus  Damage and applies a  Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown.
Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits.
Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.

tiers.text: -6s Cooldown on Hero Headshots. -3s on NPC Headshots

citadel_weapon_bull_set.name: Case Closed
citadel_weapon_bull_set.desc: Reloads single shells at a time. Can be interrupted

citadel_ability_bull_charge.name: Shoulder Charge
citadel_ability_bull_charge.quip: Charge into the fray, dragging enemies along
citadel_ability_bull_charge.desc:
Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun.
If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.

tiers.text:
-18s Cooldown
On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s

citadel_ability_passive_beefy.name: Infernal Resilience
citadel_ability_passive_beefy.quip: Regenerate some of the damage you receive
citadel_ability_passive_beefy.desc: Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.

citadel_ability_bull_leap.name: Seismic Impact
citadel_ability_bull_leap.quip: Smash into enemies from above, stunning them
citadel_ability_bull_leap.desc: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.

tiers.text: On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius

citadel_ability_bull_heal.name: Siphon Life
citadel_ability_bull_heal.desc: Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

tiers.text: +2m Radius and +18 DPS with improved Spirit scaling

citadel_weapon_bebop_set.name: Humble Pie
citadel_weapon_bebop_set.desc: Fires a continuous beam with no bullet travel

citadel_ability_uppercut.name: Exploding Uppercut
citadel_ability_uppercut.desc:
Deal melee damage to nearby enemies and apply knockback.
When they land, they deal spirit damage and apply reduced fire rate to other nearby enemies.
Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.

tiers.text: On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +30% weapon damage for 9s
On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restores +18% of your missing health

citadel_ability_sticky_bomb.name: Sticky Bomb
citadel_ability_sticky_bomb.quip: Plant a bomb on an enemy
citadel_ability_sticky_bomb.desc:
Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies.
If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb.
Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills

tiers.text: On Cast: +5m Move Speed and +25% Debuff Resistance for 6s

citadel_ability_bebop_laser_beam.name: Hyper Beam
citadel_ability_bebop_laser_beam.desc: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals spirit damage and applies slow.

tiers.text: Hyper Beam heals Bebop for 65% of its damage on Heroes. 20% on non-hero

citadel_ability_hook.name: Grapple Arm
citadel_ability_hook.quip: Pull in a target to you
citadel_ability_hook.desc:
Launch out a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in.
Grapple Arm can be used on allies.

ability_bebop_stickybomb2.name: Sticky Bomb
ability_bebop_stickybomb2.quip: Throw a sticky bomb on an enemy
ability_bebop_stickybomb2.desc:
Throw a Sticky Bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies.
If the bomb hits a hero, it attaches to them and deals bonus spirit damage.

citadel_weapon_cadence_set.name: Arioso Annihilator
citadel_weapon_cadence_set.desc: Shoots bursts of 4 bullets that embed a crystal shard in the target. After 1 second, the shards shatter and deal the bullet damage again. Shatter damage is doubled if 5 or more shards are embedded.

cadence_ability_anthem.name: Anthem
cadence_ability_anthem.quip: Lead the charge, inspiring allies in earshot and giving them weapon buffs
cadence_ability_anthem.desc: Burst into an inspiring song! You and any ally that comes within range get an instant reload with an extra large clip, and have a Fire Rate bonus that increases until the song ends.

cadence_ability_lullaby.name: Lullaby
cadence_ability_lullaby.quip: Lull any foe you come within earshot of to sleep.
cadence_ability_lullaby.desc: Lull your foes to sleep! Any enemy that comes in range of Cadence sleeps until woken by damage, Cadence goes out of range, or the song ends. Cadence has bonus regeneration while singing.

cadence_ability_silencecontraptions.name: Silence Contraptions
cadence_ability_silencecontraptions.quip: Start a melee brawl. No guns allowed.
cadence_ability_silencecontraptions.desc: Disarm yourself perform a long-range dash melee attack. For the duration of the song, you remain disarmed and your melee abilities apply a debuff that disarms and EMP's enemy targets.

cadence_ability_crescendo.name: Crescendo
cadence_ability_crescendo.quip: Encase enemies in glass then shatter it
cadence_ability_crescendo.desc: Encase nearby enemies in glass in an increasing range over a short duration. Cadence then breaks the glass with her powerful voice, breaking any shields on the them, damaging them, and giving them massive bullet vulnerability for a duraiton after.

citadel_ability_chrono_pulse_grenade.name: Pulse Grenade
citadel_ability_chrono_pulse_grenade.quip: Throw a grenade that pulses, dealing damage and time slowing
citadel_ability_chrono_pulse_grenade.desc: Throw a grenade that begins pulsing when it lands. Each pulse expands the radius and applies spirit damage, time slow, and stacking increased damage for Paradox against the victim.

tiers.text: +20 Pulse Damage and increased Spirit scaling

citadel_ability_chrono_time_wall.name: Time Wall
citadel_ability_chrono_time_wall.quip: Create a wall that greatly slows projectiles
citadel_ability_chrono_time_wall.desc:
Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets.
Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed.

tiers.text: The wall speeds up Paradox's movement.

citadel_ability_chrono_kinetic_carbine.name: Kinetic Carbine
citadel_ability_chrono_kinetic_carbine.quip: Charge up your weapon to deal high damage and timestop
citadel_ability_chrono_kinetic_carbine.desc:
Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging.
While in the air and charging, [ADS] to timeslow your movement.

tiers.text: +2s Charge Hold Duration and +55% Damage Scaling

citadel_ability_chrono_swap.name: Paradoxical Swap
citadel_ability_chrono_swap.quip: Swap positions with an enemy hero.
citadel_ability_chrono_swap.desc: Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.

tiers.text: 200 Barrier for 8s. Barrier scales with Spirit
Swaps all enemies within 7m of hit target and +10% Max Health Damage

citadel_ability_stomp.name: Kinetic Pulse
citadel_ability_stomp.quip: Release a ground pulse that knocks enemies into the air
citadel_ability_stomp.desc: Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.

tiers.text: On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s

citadel_ability_void_sphere.name: Quantum Entanglement
citadel_ability_void_sphere.quip: Blink in and out of existence
citadel_ability_void_sphere.desc:
Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use.
[Alt Cast] : Bring nearby allies with you.

tiers.text:
Reduces non-ult debuffs by 50%
Replenishes 1 Charge

citadel_ability_nikuman.name: Rejuvenating Aurora
citadel_ability_nikuman.quip: Heal yourself and those around you
citadel_ability_nikuman.desc:
While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby.
You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.

tiers.text: Aura provides +4m Move Speed during channel
Full move and ability use and additionally heals +2.5% of Max Health per second

citadel_ability_self_vacuum.name: Singularity
citadel_ability_self_vacuum.quip: Pull in and stun the enemy team
citadel_ability_self_vacuum.desc: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time, applying stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.

citadel_weapon_engineer_set.name: Services Rendered
citadel_weapon_engineer_set.desc: Increases fire rate as the gun spins up

citadel_ability_mobile_resupply.name: Medicinal Specter
citadel_ability_mobile_resupply.desc: Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.

tiers.text:
+2% Max HP Regen
+3m Heal Radius
+40% Spirit Resist

citadel_ability_shieldedsentry.name: Mini Turret
citadel_ability_shieldedsentry.desc:
Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime.
Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.

tiers.text: +25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime

citadel_ability_fissure_wall.name: Spectral Wall
citadel_ability_fissure_wall.quip: Conjure a wall to block your foes
citadel_ability_fissure_wall.desc:
Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies.
After casting, press [Attack] or [Ability3] to erupt the wall early.
Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks

tiers.text: Amplifies McGinnis's damage by +20% on hit enemies for 7s

Deploy 2 Mini Turrets near the wall for 8s
+24% Slow

citadel_ability_rocket_barrage.name: Heavy Barrage
citadel_ability_rocket_barrage.desc:
Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location.
McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.

tiers.text: Applies 24% movement and dash slow for 1s
+2m Radius and +15 Damage per Rocket with increased spirit scaling

ability_blood_bomb.name: Essence Bomb
ability_blood_bomb.quip: Sacrifice some health to launch a damaging bomb
ability_blood_bomb.desc:
Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time.
Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.

tiers.text: Bombs leave a toxic mess on the ground, dealing 30% of the original damage per second, for 6s.

ability_blood_shards.name: Malice
ability_blood_shards.quip: Stack damage amplification on an enemy
ability_blood_shards.desc: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.

ability_life_drain.name: Life Drain
ability_life_drain.quip: Steal health from an enemy over time
ability_life_drain.desc:
Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced.
[Alt Cast] to give health to friendly Heroes.

tiers.text: Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.

ability_health_swap.name: Soul Exchange
ability_health_swap.quip: Swap your current health with an enemy hero's
ability_health_swap.desc: Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.

tiers.text: On cast, +60 Spirit Power, +40% Fire Rate and +50% Spirit Resistance for 8s.

citadel_ability_lightning_ball.name: Lightning Ball
citadel_ability_lightning_ball.quip: Launch a damaging ball of lightning
citadel_ability_lightning_ball.desc: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.

tiers.text: -28% move speed on hit targets and +1s Lifetime

citadel_ability_static_charge.name: Static Charge
citadel_ability_static_charge.quip: Apply a delayed area stun to an enemy hero
citadel_ability_static_charge.desc: Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.

ability_power_surge.name: Power Surge
ability_power_surge.quip: Create electric arcs with your shots
ability_power_surge.desc: Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.

tiers.text:
+3m Move Speed
+8 Damage and increased scaling

citadel_ability_storm_cloud.name: Storm Cloud
citadel_ability_storm_cloud.quip: Fry all enemies in a large area
citadel_ability_storm_cloud.desc: Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.

tiers.text: +55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud

+7s Channel Time
+10m Final Radius
+5m Initial Radius

ability_sleep_dagger.name: Sleep Dagger
ability_sleep_dagger.desc: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.

tiers.text: -10% Bullet Resist Reduction for 6s on wake-up

-17s Cooldown
-40% Move and Dash Speed for 3s on wake-up

ability_smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
ability_smoke_bomb.desc: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.

tiers.text:
Dispels non-ult debuffs
Grants +50% Bullet Lifesteal for 5s

ability_stacking_damage.name: Fixation
ability_stacking_damage.quip: Deal increasing bullet damage to a target
ability_stacking_damage.desc: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.

tiers.text: 40 Spirit damage and 12% slow for 2s to target every 20 stacks

+0.11/ per Stack
Scales with Weapon Damage

ability_bullet_flurry.name: Bullet Dance
ability_bullet_flurry.quip: Unleash a flurry of bullets around you
ability_bullet_flurry.desc: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.

citadel_ability_hornet_chain.name: Stake
citadel_ability_hornet_chain.quip: Tether your enemies to the ground
citadel_ability_hornet_chain.desc: Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.

citadel_ability_hornet_leap.name: Flight
citadel_ability_hornet_leap.quip: Take flight and empower your weapon
citadel_ability_hornet_leap.desc: Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.

tiers.text:
Hero Kills Refresh Duration.
+10 Spirit Damage with increased Spirit scaling

citadel_ability_hornet_sting.name: Crow Familiar
citadel_ability_hornet_sting.quip: Make a target bleed over time
citadel_ability_hornet_sting.desc: Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.

citadel_ability_hornet_snipe.name: Assassinate
citadel_ability_hornet_snipe.quip: Snipe injured targets for massive damage
citadel_ability_hornet_snipe.desc: Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.

ability_fire_bomb.name: Concussive Combustion
ability_fire_bomb.quip: Stun all nearby enemies after a short delay
ability_fire_bomb.desc:
Become a living bomb, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to all nearby enemies after a delay.
Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.

ability_flame_dash.name: Flame Dash
ability_flame_dash.quip: Blaze forward, leaving a flame trail in your wake
ability_flame_dash.desc:
Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals spirit damage over time.
Hold [Move Forward] while active to dash farther.

tiers.text: Enable 2 Ability Charges with 14s Recharge time

ability_incendiary_projectile.name: Napalm
ability_incendiary_projectile.quip: Spew napalm that amplifies your damage
ability_incendiary_projectile.desc: Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing spirit damage, applying slow, and coating targets in napalm.

tiers.text: Napalm Effect: +17% Damage Taken and -33% Healing

ability_afterburn.name: Afterburn
ability_afterburn.quip: Shoot enemies to set them on fire
ability_afterburn.desc:
Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time.
Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.

ability_icebeam.name: Arctic Beam
ability_icebeam.desc: Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.

tiers.text: -20% to Fire Rate and Move Speed
-13s Cooldown and Fires 2 additional Arctic Beams within 10m of the last target hit.

ability_icepath.name: Ice Path
ability_icepath.quip: Speed around on a floating path of ice
ability_icepath.desc:
Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail.
Press [Roll] / [Crouch] to travel up or down while in Ice Path.

tiers.text: +2m Move Speed and +35% Bullet Resist for Kelvin while on Ice Path
+35% Spirit and +20 Spirit for Kelvin while on Ice Path

ability_ice_grenade.name: Frost Grenade
ability_ice_grenade.desc: Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.

tiers.text: -10 Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.

ability_ice_dome.name: Frozen Shelter
ability_ice_dome.desc:
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed.
Objectives become Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter

tiers.text:
Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.
+65 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling

citadel_ability_lash.name: Grapple
citadel_ability_lash.quip: Use your whip to pull yourself to an enemy
citadel_ability_lash.desc: Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes.

tiers.text: +20m Cast Range and gain +7 Weapon Damage for 6s

+1 Charges
OnCast : +1 Stamina and +60% Air Control

citadel_ability_lash_down_strike.name: Ground Strike
citadel_ability_lash_down_strike.quip: Slam down to the ground, damaging enemies
citadel_ability_lash_down_strike.desc: Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.

tiers.text: Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by 40% for 3s
Damage Per Meter +120% and improved scaling

citadel_ability_lash_ultimate.name: Death Slam
citadel_ability_lash_ultimate.quip: Lift enemies and smash them into the ground
citadel_ability_lash_ultimate.desc:
Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed.
Press [Attack] to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.

tiers.text:
Stun enemies in Radius for 1.2s
+6m Cast Range

ability_lash_flog.name: Flog
ability_lash_flog.quip: Heals from targets ahead of you
ability_lash_flog.desc: Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

mirage_tornado.name: Dust Devil
mirage_tornado.quip: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that lifts enemies
mirage_tornado.desc: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies, slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion.

mirage_sand_phantom.name: Djinn's Mark
mirage_sand_phantom.desc: Active: Consume all Djinn Marks to deal their damage now.

tiers.text: On Proc: Apply a fading 48% Slow for 0.8s

-0.75s Cooldown
+1 Max Marks
Stun Victim for 0.5s on Max Marks

mirage_fire_beetles.name: Fire Scarabs
mirage_fire_beetles.quip: Send out scarabs that steal life from enemies
mirage_fire_beetles.desc: Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.

mirage_teleport.name: Traveler
mirage_teleport.quip: Teleport to an ally or enemy hero
mirage_teleport.desc: Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.

tiers.text: +3m Move Speed and +20% Fire Rate for 12s

ability_intimidate.name: Scorn
ability_intimidate.quip: Damage enemies nearby, healing from each hit
ability_intimidate.desc: Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.

tiers.text: Adds a debuff to enemies that lets Mo & Krill deal +15% Damage to them. Stacks and lasts 16s.

ability_burrow.name: Burrow
ability_burrow.quip: Travel underground, emerging with spin damage
ability_burrow.desc:
Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus.
When you jump out, deal spirit damage, slow, and knockup.

ability_throw_sand.name: Sand Blast
ability_throw_sand.quip: Disarm enemies in front of you
ability_throw_sand.desc: Spray sand that disarms enemies in front of you and deals damage.

tiers.text: Slow targets by -24% and reduces dash distances by -26%

ability_ult_combo.name: Combo
ability_ult_combo.quip: Hold the enemy hero in place and pummel them
ability_ult_combo.desc: Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.

tiers.text: +0.7s Duration and +40 Damage Per Second and increased scaling

ability_nano_pounce.name: Pounce
ability_nano_pounce.desc:
Leap at a target to inflict Light Melee damage and slow on nearby enemies.
You may use Pounce on a second target if used within 3s

tiers.text: Reloads up to 20% of your ammo and applies +30% Fire Rate Slow.

ability_nano_proximity_ritual.name: Nekomata Ward
ability_nano_proximity_ritual.quip: Deploy a statue that surveys an area
ability_nano_proximity_ritual.desc: Deploy a Statue to track enemies in an area. The Ward will also attack enemies recently damaged by Calico. Targeted enemies have reduced healing and heal Calico when damaged.

tiers.text: Statues gain Invisibility when not attacking.
-30% Damage Reduction and -30% Heal Reduction on targets.

ability_nano_shadow_step.name: Queen of Shadows
ability_nano_shadow_step.quip: Enter the shadows to gain the advantage on your enemies
ability_nano_shadow_step.desc: Mark your enemies and bathe yourself in shadow to strengthen your attacks and make yourself Invisible. Attacking will only temporarily reveal you. Hitting enemies with Melee damage will reduce their bullet resist (stacking)

tiers.text: Heavy Melee attacks cause Silence for 3s

ability_nano_catform.name: Ava
ability_nano_catform.desc:
Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become  hidden on the minimap.
Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.

tiers.text: Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 18%. Lingers for 6s

ability_nano_clustergrenade.name: Gloom Bombs
ability_nano_clustergrenade.desc:
Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing spirit damage.
Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.

tiers.text: Per Bomb Touch : -6% Melee Resist for 6s

ability_nano_shadow_pulse.name: Return to Shadows
ability_nano_shadow_pulse.quip: Turn to Shadows, gaining movespeed and dealing delayed damage
ability_nano_shadow_pulse.desc:
Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining bonus move speed, and dealing spirit damage.
After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing spirit damage again.

tiers.text: On Completion: Heal for 450 and refund all ability cooldowns

ability_nano_dash.name: Leaping Slash
ability_nano_dash.desc:
Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing melee damage.
If the ability hits at least one hero, heal a small amount of health.

tiers.text: +60 Damage & On Hero Hit: 50% Cooldown Refund

ability_charged_shot.name: Charged Shot
ability_charged_shot.quip: Charge up a long range shot
ability_charged_shot.desc: Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold [Ability1] or [Attack] to hold the shot.

tiers.text: Improved damage scaling and -3s Charge Delay

ability_power_jump.name: Rain of Arrows
ability_power_jump.quip: Jump high up in the air and unleash multishots
ability_power_jump.desc:
Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon.
[Alt Cast] for reduced jump height.
Press [Mantle] to cancel the glide.

tiers.text: While airborne, +3 Weapon Damage and weapon damage applies 24% movement slow for 1.5s
While airborne, +30% Bullet Lifesteal, +30% Spirit Lifesteal and +30% Bullet Evasion

ability_immobilize_trap.name: Spirit Snare
ability_immobilize_trap.quip: Place a trap that restricts enemy movement
ability_immobilize_trap.desc:
Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage.
Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.

ability_guided_arrow.name: Guided Owl
ability_guided_arrow.quip: Fly your owl to damage enemies from afar
ability_guided_arrow.desc:
After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold [Move Forward] to accelerate the owl.
Press [Mantle] to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.

tiers.text: After hit, kills enemies that are below 22% Health

citadel_ability_shiv_dagger.name: Serrated Knives
citadel_ability_shiv_dagger.quip: Apply stacking bleed to the target
citadel_ability_shiv_dagger.desc: Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.

tiers.text: +12 Bleed DPS with increased Spirit scaling

citadel_ability_shiv_dash.name: Slice and Dice
citadel_ability_shiv_dash.quip: Dash ahead, damaging all enemies along the path
citadel_ability_shiv_dash.desc: Perform a dash forward, damaging enemies along the path. Hit Enemies have their spirit resist reduced. This debuff can stack.

tiers.text:
+50 Impact Damage
-2s Cooldown per Hero hit.

citadel_ability_shiv_defer_damage.name: Bloodletting
citadel_ability_shiv_defer_damage.quip: Defer a portion of damage taken
citadel_ability_shiv_defer_damage.desc: Take only a portion of incoming damage immediately and defer the rest to be taken over time. Activate to clear a portion of the deferred damage.

citadel_ability_shiv_killing_blow.name: Killing Blow
citadel_ability_shiv_killing_blow.quip: Travel to a low health hero and instantly kill it

tiers.text:
+6 m Range
+2 m/s in Full Rage.

citadel_weapon_slork_set.name: Poison Sprayer
citadel_weapon_slork_set.desc: Spews a short range toxic cloud that deals double damage to non-hero targets. When aimed, shoots a long range dart that poisons enemies.

fathom_scalding_spray.name: Scalding Spray
fathom_scalding_spray.quip: Spray scalding water in a cone ahead of you.
fathom_scalding_spray.desc: Spray scalding water in a cone ahead of you. You build up bonus weapon damage as the spray damages an enemy hero.

fathom_breach.name: Breach
fathom_breach.desc: Launch forward, damaging all enemies near where you land and knocking them into the air.

fathom_reefdweller_harpoon.name: Reefdweller Harpoon
fathom_reefdweller_harpoon.quip: Throw a harpoon to pull yourself towards a surface.
fathom_reefdweller_harpoon.desc:
Throw a harpoon that latches to a wall or ceiling, and pulls you in. Activates Lurker's Ambush's invisibility while being pulled in. Once hanging attached to the harpoon surface, gain additional charges.
Casting Reefdweller Harpoon does not break invisibility.

tiers.text: After detaching, gain 30% Fire Rate for 7s or until you reload

fathom_lurkers_ambush.name: Lurker's Ambush
fathom_lurkers_ambush.quip: Become invisible and launch an immobilizing spit.

synth_plasma_flux.name: Flying Cloak
synth_plasma_flux.quip: Launch a damaging cloak that you can teleport to
synth_plasma_flux.desc: Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press  [Ability2]  to teleport to its location.

synth_pulse.name: Enchanter's Satchel
synth_pulse.quip: Briefly escape into your suitcase, then deal damage
synth_pulse.desc: Escape into your suitcase. When the duration ends, deal spirit damage to nearby enemies. Duration can be ended early by performing any action.

tiers.text:
+1.5s Duration
+4m Radius
-32% Move Speed and Fire Rate for 4s

synth_barrage.name: Barrage
synth_barrage.quip: Air glide while firing multiple projectiles
synth_barrage.desc:
Channel to start launching projectiles that deal spirit damage and apply slow around their impact point. Projectiles that hit a hero grant Pocket increased damage that stacks.
Casting while airborne will cause Pocket to float.
Casting AirDash or Flying Cloak will not cancel Barrage.

synth_affliction.name: Affliction
synth_affliction.quip: Apply damage over time to enemies nearby
synth_affliction.desc:
Applies damage over time to enemies nearby.
Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

tiers.text:
Prevents all healing
+13 DPS with increased Spirit scaling

citadel_ability_tangotether.name: Kudzu Connection
citadel_ability_tangotether.quip: Empower yourself and a nearby ally
citadel_ability_tangotether.desc:
Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting.
Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection
Connection requires line of sight.

citadel_ability_tengu_urn.name: Entangling Thorns
citadel_ability_tengu_urn.quip: Damage and slow enemies in the area
citadel_ability_tengu_urn.desc: Summon a patch of choking thorns that damages and slows enemies in its radius.

tiers.text: +2m Radius and increased DPS Spirit scaling
Enemies caught in thorns for 2s are Immobilized for +1.6s

citadel_ability_tengu_stone_form.name: Stone Form
citadel_ability_tengu_stone_form.quip: Turn into impervious stone and stun enemies nearby
citadel_ability_tengu_stone_form.desc: Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.

tiers.text: +0.75s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling

citadel_ability_tengu_airlift.name: Air Drop
citadel_ability_tengu_airlift.quip: Death from Above! Fly and drop an ally on enemies
citadel_ability_tengu_airlift.desc:
Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends.
Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies.
Taking damage briefly disables using the ability.
While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.

tiers.text: On Fly End : 300 Barrier to Ivy and ally that scales with Spirit

Silence for 3s on enemies hit.
Increases damage and barrier scaling.

viscous_goo_grenade.name: Splatter
viscous_goo_grenade.quip: Damage enemies and make a mess
viscous_goo_grenade.desc: Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.

viscous_restorative_goo.name: The Cube
viscous_restorative_goo.quip: The Cube is a safe place to be
viscous_restorative_goo.desc: Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press  [Mantle]  to escape early.

tiers.text: Increases Move Speed and Stamina Recovery
Removes all non-ult Debuffs and -20s Cooldown

viscous_goo_bowling_ball.name: Goo Ball
viscous_goo_bowling_ball.desc: Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.

tiers.text: +7s Duration, +0.3s Stun Duration, and +0.2 Spirit Scaling

viscous_telepunch.name: Puddle Punch
viscous_telepunch.quip: Punch enemies with a giant fist
viscous_telepunch.desc:
Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup.
Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow. Enemies can Parry this attack.
You and your allies have increased Air Control.

tiers.text: -14s Cooldown and now deals Heavy Melee Damage

ability_warden_lock_down.name: Binding Word
ability_warden_lock_down.quip: Curse your target, rooting them if they don't escape
ability_warden_lock_down.desc: Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time, they will be damaged and immobilized.

tiers.text: Warden deals +20% more Bullet Damage to trapped Heroes for 5s

-14s Cooldown
Silences enemies until they escape or are immobilized

ability_warden_high_alert.name: Willpower
ability_warden_high_alert.quip: Gain a Barrier and move speed
ability_warden_high_alert.desc: Gain a Barrier and bonus move speed.

tiers.text: +30% Debuff Resistance and improved Barrier scaling

ability_warden_crowd_control.name: Alchemical Flask
ability_warden_crowd_control.desc: Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.

tiers.text:
-7s Cooldown and +2m Radius
Applies -30% Fire Rate

ability_warden_riot_protocol.name: Last Stand
ability_warden_riot_protocol.quip: Emit pulses that steal health from enemies
ability_warden_riot_protocol.desc:
After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done.
While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.

tiers.text:
+4s Duration
Unstoppable and +30% Resists while channeling

citadel_ability_psychic_lift.name: Telekinesis
citadel_ability_psychic_lift.quip: Lift an enemy, interrupting and silencing them
citadel_ability_psychic_lift.desc: Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location.

tiers.text: +1.5s Debuff Duration and +6m Throw and Cast Range
300 Barrier for 5s. Barrier scales with Spirit Power.

citadel_ability_wraith_rapidfire.name: Full Auto
citadel_ability_wraith_rapidfire.desc: Temporarily boost your fire rate and deal bonus spirit damage

tiers.text: Unlimited Ammo and Increased Scaling on Spirit Damage Per Bullet

citadel_ability_card_toss.name: Card Trick
citadel_ability_card_toss.desc:
Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending on its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair.
Alt-cast to throw first card

tiers.text: All suits are improved and higher chance for Jokers

ability_wrecker_salvage.name: Consume
ability_wrecker_salvage.quip: Consume an enemy trooper or neutral
ability_wrecker_salvage.desc: Latches onto an Enemy, damaging them and healing yourself while attached. Targets must be in line of sight and within max range to stay latched. A successful kill also restores a Bio Blast charge.

ability_scrap_blast.name: Bio Blast
ability_scrap_blast.quip: Shoot a blast of bio mass
ability_scrap_blast.desc: Shoots out a blast of consumed remains, damaging and slowing enemies. Multiple hits increase the slow.

ability_wrecker_ultimate.name: Magnetic Flux
ability_wrecker_ultimate.desc: Grabs any enemy looked at by Wrecker, putting them in stasis and holding them overhead. Stuns, and damages all captured enemies when finished. Any grabbed NPCs are salvaged.

ability_wrecker_teleport.name: Astral Walk
ability_wrecker_teleport.quip: Launch a flying illusion of yourself, teleporting your real body where the illusion lands
ability_wrecker_teleport.desc: Launch a flying shadow copy of yourself that you control, teleporting your original body to wherever it lands. The teleport explosion slows enemies and deals damage based on how long you were flying.

citadel_ability_wrecker_garbage_suck.name: Overload
citadel_ability_wrecker_garbage_suck.desc: Create an area that slows nearby enemies and damages them after a channel. Damage scales with total channel time.

citadel_ability_wrecker_bouldergrenade.name: Wrecking Ball
citadel_ability_wrecker_bouldergrenade.desc: Create a large ball of scrap, damaging and stunning the first enemy hit. Nearby enemies take reduced damage.

citadel_ability_power_slash.name: Power Slash
citadel_ability_power_slash.quip: Charge up an attack, dealing high damage on a full charge
citadel_ability_power_slash.desc:
Channel to increase damage over 1.4 seconds, then release a fully-charged sword strike.
Press [Ability1] or [Attack] to trigger the strike early, dealing partial damage.

tiers.text:
+8m Cast Range
+150 Damage and Increases Spirit Power scaling

citadel_ability_flying_strike.name: Flying Slash
citadel_ability_flying_strike.desc: Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealingmelee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.

tiers.text:
Alt-Cast to Grapple allies
+15m Cast Range
Gains 1 extra charge

citadel_ability_healing_slash.name: Crimson Slash
citadel_ability_healing_slash.quip: Damage enemies nearby, healing on hit
citadel_ability_healing_slash.desc: Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.

tiers.text: On Hero Hit : +6% Max Health Heal

citadel_ability_infinity_slash.name: Shadow Transformation
citadel_ability_infinity_slash.desc:
Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster. You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.

ability_viper_hookdagger.name: Hook Blade
ability_viper_hookdagger.quip: Throw a blade that returns to you
ability_viper_hookdagger.desc: Throw a blade, dealing Spirit Damage. The blade then hooks back, applying Spirit Damage again and applying a Slow.

ability_viper_snakedash.name: Slither
ability_viper_snakedash.quip: Increase the agility of your Slide
ability_viper_snakedash.desc: You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.

ability_viper_venom.name: Lethal Venom
ability_viper_venom.quip: Inject your enemies with a deadly venom
ability_viper_venom.desc:
Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health.
Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.

tiers.text: Bullets also build up Lethal Venom

ability_viper_ult.name: Petrify
ability_viper_ult.quip: Turn both allies and enemies into stone
ability_viper_ult.desc: Create a hexed area on the ground. After a delay, ALL units in the cylindrical area are Petrified. Enemies also suffer Spirit Damage. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.

ability_viper_debuffdagger.name: Screwjab Dagger
ability_viper_debuffdagger.desc:
Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow.
Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow.

tiers.text: On Hit: -8% Bullet Resist and -6% Bullet Resist per Stack

+2 Max Stacks
-2s Charge Delay
On Hit: Refund 55% Charge Cooldown

ability_viper_petrifybola.name: Petrifying Bola
ability_viper_petrifybola.desc:
Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola  Slows and  Damages all enemies in the area.
Direct hits deal  Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.

tiers.text: +1s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.

ability_magician_magicbolt.name: Vexing Bolt
ability_magician_magicbolt.quip: Launch a guided bolt of magic
ability_magician_magicbolt.desc:
Fire a bolt of magic that deals  Damage, increasing as it travels. If you have an Assistant, they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage.
Press  [Ability1]  to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.

ability_magician_animalcurse.name: Rabbit Hex
ability_magician_animalcurse.quip: Transform your enemy into a rabbit
ability_magician_animalcurse.desc:
Hex a target, transforming them into a Rabbit for a limited duration.
Rabbits are small and  move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions.
Hex does not interrupt abilities.

ability_magician_shadowclone.name: The Great Homunculus!
ability_magician_shadowclone.desc:
Create a Copy of yourself with reduced health and damage. When the clone dies or expires it explodes, dealing Spirit Damage.
The Copy cannot use their Ultimate ability.

tiers.text: Copy can cast their Ultimate Ability.

ability_magician_cloneturret.name: Spectral Assistant
ability_magician_cloneturret.desc:
Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing  Damage.
While the Assistant is out, you can press  [Ability2]  to swap positions with your Assistant.
Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.

ability_magician_stage.name: Captive Audience
ability_magician_stage.desc: Target an enemy. You and the target enemy are bound on Stage, unable to leave. All other characters are pushed out of the radius.

ability_magician_bigbolt.name: Grand Finale!
ability_magician_bigbolt.desc: Prepare three AMAZING bolts of magic. Each bolt applies a Fading Slow and deals Spirit Damage, increased for every bolt fired.

tiers.text: +50 Damage Per Bolt. Refund 1 Bolt per Kill

ability_magician_escape.name: Escape Artist
ability_magician_escape.desc:
Blink to the target location. On arrival, briefly gain  movement speed and become Invisible.
[Cast] Appear at the target location.
[Alt Cast]  Appear in place.
Enemies will not know which cast you performed.

ability_magician_copyult.name: Audience Participation
ability_magician_copyult.quip: Copy an enemy's Ultimate for a limited time
ability_magician_copyult.desc:
Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead.
Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points.
Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.

ability_magician_animalhexarea.name: Rabbit Hex
ability_magician_animalhexarea.desc:
Hex a target area and transform all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration.
Rabbits are small and  move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions.
Hex does not interrupt abilities.

ability_trapper_poisonjar.name: Bottled Phantasmicide
ability_trapper_poisonjar.desc: Throw a jar that leaves a spreading toxic pool. Enemies caught in the pool are Slowed and  Silenced.

tiers.text: -25% Spirit Resist for enemies in the pool

ability_trapper_spiderwave.name: Crawling Plague
ability_trapper_spiderwave.quip: Release a wave of spectral spiders
ability_trapper_spiderwave.desc:
Release a wave of spectral spiders that chase enemies and explode, dealing  Spirit Damage.
Hit enemies are poisoned, temporarily losing  Spirit and  Spirit Resist. This effect can stack multiple times.

ability_trapper_spidershield.name: Pest Barrier
ability_trapper_spidershield.desc: Apply a Combat Barrier to a target ally and periodically deal  Spirit Damage and  Slows.

ability_trapper_fear.name: Spectral Silk
ability_trapper_fear.desc:
Dealing Spirit Damage builds an increasing Slow. Once full, the buildup is consumed to apply an Immobilize and a burst of Spirit Damage.
This effect has a cooldown per target.

ability_trapper_webwall.name: Silktrap
ability_trapper_webwall.desc: Create a thread of web between two surfaces. Enemies who touch the web take  Damage over time, become  Slowed and are  Revealed.

tiers.text: +2s Debuff Duration. The Web also Silences for 2.5s

operative_umbrella_maneuver.name: Umbrella Maneuver
operative_umbrella_maneuver.desc: Use your umbrella to catch a gust of wind that lifts you backwards. You then charge up your umbrella to fire a projectile that explodes on impact.

operative_revelation.name: Revelation
operative_revelation.desc: Activate your relic. Enemy heroes nearby have slowed movement and dashes, and receive damage over time when looking towards you. If enemies look at you long enough, they get cursed.

ability_gunslinger_spreadingfire.name: Flame Imp
ability_gunslinger_spreadingfire.desc:
Throw a projectile, infused with an imp's spirit. It posseses the enemy, dealing  Damage over time.
If the target dies while possessed, the imp jumps to another nearby enemy, refreshing its duration.

tiers.text: +25 DPS. Spreads to +1 targets after death.

ability_gunslinger_demon_carbine.name: Hellfire Salvo
ability_gunslinger_demon_carbine.desc: Load your weapon with demonic rounds. After a delay, you empower your next shots to deal bonus damage and penetrate enemies.

ability_gunslinger_salvo.name: Demontrigger Blitz
ability_gunslinger_salvo.desc:
Load your weapon with demonic rounds. After a delay, release a blitz of bullets at the target enemy, dealing bonus  Damage.
Enemies can intercept the bullets.

gunslinger_demonMark.name: Infernal Brand
gunslinger_demonMark.desc: Passively mark nearby enemies with a Brand. Shooting an enemy with a Brand consumes the effect, dealing bonus  Damage and granting  Fire Rate and  Movement Speed.

ability_vampirebat_batblink.name: Sanguine Retreat
ability_vampirebat_batblink.desc:
Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location.
Can be recast within a brief window.

tiers.text: On Cast: Gain +25% Fire Rate for 8s and add 8 bullets

ability_vampirebat_lovebites.name: Love Bites
ability_vampirebat_lovebites.desc:
Your bullets apply additional spirit damage. Dealing damage with your abilities builds up to a vicious bite, dealing a burst of bonus spirit damage.
Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.

tiers.text:
+3 Spirit Damage per Bullet &
+45 Bonus Damage

-5 Cooldown
On Proc: +25% Fire Rate for 5s

ability_vampirebat_batswarm.name: Nox Nostra
ability_vampirebat_batswarm.desc:
Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence.
Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.

tiers.text: On Hit: Deal +0.5% Current Health as Damage

ability_vampirebat_steallife.name: Rake
ability_vampirebat_steallife.desc:
Active: Slash with your umbrella, dealing spirit damage, increasing with their missing health. Receive a heal for every target killed.
Passive: Holding [ADS] causes you to briefly float.
Rake executes non-heroes below 60 health.

tiers.text: +7% Missing health damage and increased Heal per Kill Spirit scaling

ability_swan_leap.name: Jeté
ability_swan_leap.desc: Leap in a target direction. If no direction is chosen, then leap straight up instead.

ability_swan_acrobat.name: Acrobat
ability_swan_acrobat.desc:
Gain stacking bonuses every time you dash, double jump, wall jump, or teleport.
Gaining new stacks refreshes the duration.

ability_skyrunner_flakshot.name: Flakshot
ability_skyrunner_flakshot.desc: Bullets deal bonus weapon damage and can ricochet off of surfaces.

ability_skyrunner_swingline.name: Lifethread
ability_skyrunner_swingline.desc:
Fire a line that attaches to the world, allowing you to swing.
Lifethread resets all air jumps and air dashes.

ability_frank_selfzap.name: Jumpstart
ability_frank_selfzap.desc: Deal spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus regeneration and bonus move speed, decaying over time.

tiers.text:
+1 Charge
+50% Debuff Resistance
Increases spirit scaling

ability_frank_painaura.name: Aura of Suffering
ability_frank_painaura.desc:
Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself.
The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.

tiers.text: Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow

ability_frank_revive.name: Shocking Reanimation
ability_frank_revive.desc:
Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow.
After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.

tiers.text: While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6 Spirit Damage per Bullet

ability_frank_shocktarget2.name: Pain Battery
ability_frank_shocktarget2.desc:
Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery.
Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing spirit damage once per target.

tiers.text: On Hero Hit: Heal for 15% of your missing health and increased Spirit scaling

ability_bookworm_dragonfire.name: Bookwyrm
ability_bookworm_dragonfire.desc: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.

ability_bookworm_aoemagic.name: Captivating Read
ability_bookworm_aoemagic.desc:
Target an area with latent magic, applying slow.
The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize.

tiers.text:
+2m Radius
On Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by -18% for 6s

ability_bookworm_knightbarrier.name: Plot Armor
ability_bookworm_knightbarrier.desc: Grant an ally a barrier. While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage.

tiers.text:
Affects up to 2 additional allies.
Increases barrier scaling.

ability_bookworm_knightcharge.name: Rallying Charge
ability_bookworm_knightcharge.desc:
Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies.
The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.

ability_doorman_doorway.name: Doorway
ability_doorman_doorway.desc:
Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration.
The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.

tiers.text: Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors

+30m Cast Range. +40m Doorway Distance

ability_werewolf_cripplingslash.desc: Smash enemies around you, dealing spirit damage. They suffer from disarm and a brief slow.

ability_werewolf_transformation.name: Lycan Curse
ability_werewolf_transformation.desc:
Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse.
Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health, and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.

tiers.text: +4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration

ability_werewolf_passive.name: ability_werewolf_passive
ability_werewolf_passive.desc:
Human:Track the last hero you hit. Killing tracked enemies grants bonus souls.
Werewolf:Track any low-health heroes nearby. Killing tracked heroes reduce your cooldowns.

ability_werewolf_onthehunt.name: On The Hunt
ability_werewolf_onthehunt.desc: Gain bonus fire rate and bonus move speed, half to nearby allies. Kills during this time recasts On The Hunt.

ability_werewolf_transformation_trigger.name: End the Curse
ability_werewolf_transformation_trigger.desc: Return back to your human form.

ability_werewolf_frenzy.name: Go For The Throat
ability_werewolf_frenzy.desc: Deal melee damage to all enemies in front of you, receiving a heal for a portion of the damage dealt. The damage is increased the lower health they have.

ability_werewolf_leap.name: Crushing Leap
ability_werewolf_leap.desc: Leap through the air before landing, dealing melee damage and applying slow to nearby enemies while pushing them away.

tiers.text: On Landing: +2 m/s Move Speed for 5s

ability_unicorn_radiantblast.name: Light Eater
ability_unicorn_radiantblast.desc: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.

ability_unicorn_prismaticguard.name: Dazzling Trick
ability_unicorn_prismaticguard.desc: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.

tiers.text: +70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
+1.25 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.

ability_unicorn_dazzlingorb.name: Shining Wonder
ability_unicorn_dazzlingorb.desc:
Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.
Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.

ability_unicorn_luminousstrike.name: Radiant Daggers
ability_unicorn_luminousstrike.desc:
Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area.
Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

tiers.text: +4% Spirit Amp and +9% Fire Rate Per Stack

ability_ratking_ratnibble.name: Rat Swarm
ability_ratking_ratnibble.desc:
Call forth a swarm of rats that leap onto enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and reducing their bullet resist with every bite. The more rats are attached, the faster they will bite the target.
Enemies can have multiple rats attached, but can shake off a rat early by performing a ground or air dash.

tiers.text: +8 Damage and -1% Bullet Resist per Bite

ability_ratking_scrap_grenade.name: Scrap Grenade
ability_ratking_scrap_grenade.desc:
Throw a grenade of scrap that detonates multiple times, dealing bullet damage and applying slow.
The grenade can be meleed to knock it away.

tiers.text: Add an additional final Bigger Detonation

ability_ratking_ratarmor.name: Royal Pestments
ability_ratking_ratarmor.desc:
Adorn scrappy armor, gaining barrier based on your max health. As long as the armor holds, bullets have a chance to be deflected back towards the attacker.
The barrier does not benefit from resists.

tiers.text:
Reduce all damage to a max of 250
+10% Max Health as Barrier

ability_ratking_standard_bearer.name: Rule, Ratannia!
ability_ratking_standard_bearer.desc: Charge up and summon the banner of Ratannia, granting all nearby allies increased move speed, immunity from slows, and reduced incoming damage while near the banner.
